findings.body: The code now builds a shell command string by directly interpolating the `user` parameter into `report --user {user}` and executes it via `sh -c`. Any shell metacharacters in `user` (e.g. `;`, `|`, `$(...)`, backticks) will be interpreted by the shell, allowing arbitrary command execution. findings.body: The function now returns `rows.into_iter().skip(1).collect()`, discarding the first row entirely. This directly contradicts the spec requirement that rendering shall preserve every row.

findings.title: Do not drop the first row when returning rows

findings.body: The test was renamed from `preserves_rows` to `returns_rows` and weakened to only assert the result is non-empty, instead of checking that all rows are preserved and equal to the input.
